dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL on Linux; uses ORCDBMAIN database call pattern and COPY-based linkage typical of ORCA system
evidence: OS LINUX noted in header comments

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim recalculation subsystem (負担金再計算サブ) for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram (ORCSSAIKEISAN) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that performs recalculation of patient co-payment amounts (負担金再計算). It reads receipt/claim master records from a PostgreSQL-backed database via ORCDBMAIN, processes insurance combination data, and recalculates billing amounts for outpatient/inpatient claims including group claim handling.

notable_features: COPY-based record layout inclusion (25 COPY statements)
ORCDBMAIN database call pattern (MCP interface, not EXEC SQL)
LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA (service parameter area) pattern
OCCURS tables for insurance combination and billing amount arrays
42 CALL statements to various ORCA subsystem routines
Large comment block with revision history in Japanese (EUC-JP encoded)
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (displayed as latin-1 mojibake in the truncated view); Japanese comments are readable in context. File is 3436 lines, truncated to first 16000 chars for analysis. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system running on Linux with GnuCOBOL.
